correctness.rationale: With Q the eleven quadratic residues modulo 23 and action G=F23 semidirect Q, transitive tournament subsets are simplices. Independent enumeration of every subset up to size five produced exactly 506 cyclic triples and face vector (23,253,1265,2530,1518). The actual verifier constructs an acyclic discrete Morse matching with 2681 pairs, a 102x124 integral Morse boundary with Smith units 78 and one factor 23, and signed orbit invariant complexes over F1009. The known nonequivariant Z^23+Z/23 in H3 and Z^45 in H4 is from Govc and rechecked by the package, not claimed new. Independently implemented separate M=<x->2x> orbit-eigenchain reductions over F23: eigenvalue 1 Betti in degrees 3,4 is (3,5), eigenvalue 12 likewise (3,5), and each of nine others (2,4), with degree0 only at eigenvalue1. By universal coefficients the extra 23-primary degree3 eigendirection has multiplier 12, while the translation C23 acts trivially on its Z/23 torsion group. The invariant rational dimensions and unique 22-dimensional augmentation module force H3_Q=1+W and H4_Q=1+2W; rational quotient homology in degrees 3,4 is Q. Computation is exhaustive for this finite 23-vertex complex, not a uniform-family theorem.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge O PASS for the affine action on rational homology and the order-11 multiplier character on the known Z/23 torsion. Govc's 2020 classification already contains the nonequivariant homotopy type and integral homology; these are explicitly excluded from novelty. Published Resultary work at Paley 19 and Paley 31 concerns different orders and cannot determine the 23-torsion scalar. Govc's full text could not be obtained via arXiv HTML or OA mirrors and authorized institutional retrieval returned vpn_disconnected, so possible equivariant data in appendices remain a pronounced priority risk. No decisive stronger prior equivariant theorem was identified from material accessible.

value.rationale: The character of a canonical order-eleven automorphism on the 23-torsion class is a natural equivariant-topological invariant not determined by the nonequivariant wedge/Moore-space homotopy type. Together with full rational G-module decomposition and quotient Betti numbers it describes how affine symmetry acts on a famous 23-vertex directed complex, a meaningful finite classification rather than a gratuitous computation.
